style.backgroundSystem: alternating #C9807A rose-terracotta section fields and #F7F1EC / #FFFFFF copy plates, one shared 3D stage of a #F2EFEA marble-veined cylindrical podium with an #E0A79F ring base and #C9A15E ribbon arcs; deep #B46B64 draped curtain as the only depth prop
style.iconSystem: thin-line single-colour #C9807A icons inside #FFFFFF circles, rounded #FFFFFF cards with hairline numbering, hairline #C9A15E leader lines with dot terminators, #E0A79F pill bars for accessory and benefit labels
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the upper left at about 5200K, gentle #C9A15E rim tracing the silhouette, always a soft contact shadow under the product; lifestyle screens switch to directional window light with the same left-side logic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm beauty-tech personal-care appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a rose-terracotta field #C9807A, a cream plate #F7F1EC and a clean panel #FFFFFF, with one matte accent #C9A15E and one soft blush secondary #E0A79F, charcoal text #2D2D2D; warm soft studio key from the upper left at about 5200K with a gentle rim and a constant soft contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif with short Chinese copy wrapped in corner brackets; one shared 3D stage language of a #F2EFEA marble-veined cylindrical podium, an #E0A79F ring base and #C9A15E ribbon arcs, alternating #C9807A and #F7F1EC section fields; consistent thin-line #C9807A circular icons, hairline #C9A15E leader lines with dot terminators, rounded #FFFFFF cards with hairline numbering and #E0A79F pill bars; stable product scale and placement, glossy and matte finishes rendered separately; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers or certifications
style.presentationRules: one stable handheld body silhouette across the set, product centred or tilted in mid-air above the podium with a consistent scale, glossy and matte finishes rendered separately, no restyling of the body or its trims
style.surfaceSystem: #F2EFEA marble-veined stone stage and podium top, matte #F7F1EC counter plates, #FFFFFF technical plate for dimension and parameter screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; #FFFFFF two-line Chinese headlines on the #C9807A fields and #2D2D2D headlines on the light plates, one thin #C9A15E or #FFFFFF rule under each headline, short three-layer copy per screen, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」
